Hoa Sen Group Reports Steady Revenue Growth Amidst Robust Domestic Demand

Hoa Sen Group, a leading Vietnamese steel manufacturer, has announced its latest quarterly financial results, showing steady revenue growth and stable operations in the face of evolving market conditions. The company’s financial report, released on Wednesday, highlights a 7.5% increase in consolidated revenue year-on-year, reaching VND 12.8 trillion for the quarter ending March 31, 2024. Net profit after tax stood at VND 320 billion, representing a slight increase compared to the same period last year.

Company executives attributed the growth to resilient domestic demand for steel products, especially in the construction and infrastructure sectors. “We are pleased to see positive momentum in our core markets,” said Le Phuoc Vu, Chairman of Hoa Sen Group. “Our strategy of expanding distribution networks and focusing on value-added products has paid off, allowing us to maintain solid performance despite global market fluctuations.”

The Vietnamese steel industry has experienced intensified competition, with both domestic and imported products vying for market share. However, Hoa Sen Group has managed to maintain its position as one of the country’s top producers, supported by investments in manufacturing efficiency and product diversification.

“Vietnam’s construction sector continues to drive steel consumption, and companies like Hoa Sen are well-positioned to benefit from this sustained demand,” said Nguyen Van Linh, an analyst with Hanoi-based trade consultancy VietTrade Research. “While input costs have risen, Hoa Sen’s ability to optimize its supply chain has helped protect margins.”

According to the Vietnam Steel Association, total steel consumption in the first quarter of 2024 grew by 6% compared to the previous year. Industry observers note that public investment in infrastructure, along with a gradual recovery in the real estate sector, have bolstered demand for steel products, offsetting some headwinds from subdued export markets.

The company’s quarterly report also pointed to ongoing investments in digital transformation, automation, and environmental initiatives. “We recognize the importance of sustainability and innovation,” said Tran Quoc Nghia, Chief Operating Officer. “These investments not only enhance our competitiveness but also align with evolving customer expectations and regulatory requirements.”

Looking ahead, Hoa Sen Group plans to further expand its retail network and introduce new steel solutions tailored to the needs of small and medium-sized enterprises. “Our outlook remains cautiously optimistic,” added Le Phuoc Vu. “We will continue to focus on operational excellence and customer satisfaction to deliver value for our stakeholders.”

The group’s shares rose modestly on the Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange following the earnings release, reflecting investor confidence in its ongoing growth strategy.
